title: The sidebar: keep it as it is, and fold the overview into the plan
summary: You suggested no title at all: Needs you, Everything and Agent activity stay at the top as they are, and The plan heading groups everything below it as the high-level view. That's simpler, and it's the sidebar we have.

checks.text: Top, no heading: Needs you, Everything, Agent activity, as now.
The plan: the high-level view, each stage with its open count, status dot and the agent's spinner, as now.
The one change: the overview's extras (since you last looked, health, what's owed) fold in under The plan, instead of a page of their own.

why: No new heading keeps the sidebar quiet, and the plan's heading already says where the big picture starts.
